notes: Libretto by Lorenzo Da Ponte (1787). Words follow the Schirmer vocal score's spelling, punctuation and syllables, as sung: bar 1's "-var." (Giovanni and Leporello) ends "provar" from the previous piece (Già la mensa) and is left out here. "Cos' è?" is printed on two notes and kept as two words (also in "che cos' è?"); Giovanni sings "Io ti deridere!" (bar 50) and then "Io te deridere?" (bar 54), as printed; "maraviglio" (libretto meraviglio), "cosa volete?" in lower case, "perchè", "quà" as printed. "femine" (bar 125, for femmine; IPA as femmine) is kept as printed. Two clear misprints are corrected: the missing apostrophes in "l'amico" (bar 227) and "m'asconderò" (bar 229; bar 230 prints it). Lines are repeated as the score repeats them; "ad aprir io stesso andrò" and "io gelo, io manco" are on separate notes (no elision). Elvira's small ossia notes (bars 146-147) are not in the score. IPA, word meanings and translations were drafted for this app (S59), and the IPA was checked against Castel. IPA follows sung Italian conventions: stressed syllable marked, elisions (two words on one note in the score) joined with ‿, open e/o as ɛ/ɔ. Translation literal, for meaning.
